sql.commissionManagement.findActiveMilestone: SELECT id, milestone_type, display_order FROM brs.milestone_type where active is true
sql.commissionManagement.payrollSearch:
SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM (SELECT p.period_end, p.id, p.description, (SELECT sum(dcs1.current_pay) FROM brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs1 WHERE dcs1.payroll_id = p.id) AS current_pay FROM brs.payroll p INNER JOIN brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs ON p.id = dcs.payroll_id INNER JOIN brs.deal d ON dcs.deal_id = d.id LEFT JOIN brs.deal_override_commission_snapshot docs ON docs.deal_commission_snapshot_id = dcs.id WHERE CASE WHEN :startDate:: DATE IS NOT NULL THEN p.period_end BETWEEN :startDate:: DATE AND :endDate:: DATE ELSE 1 = 1 END AND CASE WHEN :customerName:: TEXT IS NOT NULL THEN lower(dcs.customer_name) LIKE lower('%' || :customerName:: TEXT || '%') ELSE 1 = 1 END AND CASE WHEN :salesRepId:: INTEGER IS NOT NULL THEN d.closer_user_id = :salesRepId:: INTEGER OR docs.user_id = :salesRepId:: INTEGER ELSE 1 = 1 END AND CASE WHEN :dealId:: INTEGER IS NOT NULL THEN d.deal_base_oid = :dealId:: INTEGER ELSE 1 = 1 END
GROUP BY p.id, p.period_end ORDER BY p.period_end desc) AS sub_rows
sql.commissionManagement.getPayrollSearchDet: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM ( SELECT s.cancelled, s.commission_adjustment, s.commission_paid_to_date, s.commission_plan, s.commission_plan_id, s.commissions_earned, s.current_pay, s.current_pay_commissions, s.current_pay_overrides, s.customer_name, s.deal_id, s.deal_total_value, s.deposit, s.final_design_signed, s.financial_agreement_sent, s.hoi, s.id, s.install_agreement_signed, s.override_adjustment, s.override_earned, s.override_plan, s.override_plan_id, s.payroll_id, s.percent_of_cash_deposit, s.remaining_value, s.remaining_value_commissions, s.remaining_value_overrides, s.sales_rep, s.sales_rep_id, s.sc, s.source, s.stage, s.system_size, s.total_commissions, s.updated, d.deal_base_oid, d.proof_of_howmeowners_insurance_required, d.utility_bill_verified_date FROM brs.deal_commission_snapshot s INNER JOIN brs.deal d ON s.deal_id = d.id WHERE payroll_id = :payrollId ) AS sub_rows
sql.commissionManagement.getUserPayrolls: select p.id, period_end, description, (select ( (select coalesce(sum(amount),0) as total from brs.deal_commission_ledger where ledger_type_id = 1 and closer_id = :userId and payroll_id = p.id) + (select coalesce(sum(paid_to_date),0) as total from brs.deal_commission_ledger where ledger_type_id = 3 and closer_id = :userId and payroll_id = p.id)) as total) as current_pay from brs.payroll p inner join brs.deal d on array[deal_base_oid] <@ p.selected_deal_ids inner join brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs on dcs.payroll_id = p.id left join brs.deal_override_commission_snapshot docs on docs.deal_commission_snapshot_id = dcs.id where (dcs.sales_rep_id = :userId or docs.user_id = :userId) and period_end >= '2019-01-01' group by p.id,period_end,description
sql.commissionManagement.customerSearch:
with override_totals as( select p.id,docs.user_id from brs.payroll p inner join brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id inner join brs.deal d on dcs.deal_id = d.id inner join brs.deal_override_commission_snapshot docs on docs.deal_commission_snapshot_id = dcs.id WHERE (docs.user_id = :userId) AND replace(lower(dcs.customer_name),' ', '') LIKE '%' || :searchQuery || '%' group by p.id,docs.user_id), commission_totals as( select p.id, d.closer_user_id from brs.payroll p inner join brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id inner join brs.deal d on dcs.deal_id = d.id where lower(dcs.customer_name) LIKE '%' || :searchQuery || '%' and d.closer_user_id = :userId group by p.id, d.closer_user_id ) select p.id, p.period_end, p.description, (with override_totals as( select p.id, docs.user_id,sum(docs.total) as override_total from brs.payroll p inner join brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id inner join brs.deal d on dcs.deal_id = d.id inner join brs.deal_override_commission_snapshot docs on docs.deal_commission_snapshot_id = dcs.id WHERE (docs.user_id = :userId) group by p.id,docs.user_id), commission_totals as( select p.id, d.closer_user_id,coalesce(sum(dcs.commissions_earned),0) - coalesce(sum(commission_paid_to_date),0) + coalesce(sum(commission_adjustment),0) as commission_total from brs.payroll p inner join brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id inner join brs.deal d on dcs.deal_id = d.id where d.closer_user_id = :userId group by p.id,d.closer_user_id)
select coalesce(commission_total,0) + coalesce(ot.override_total,0) as current_pay from brs.payroll p inner join brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id left join brs.deal_override_commission_snapshot docs on docs.deal_commission_snapshot_id = dcs.id left join override_totals ot on ot.id = p.id left join commission_totals ct on ct.id = p.id WHERE ((ot.user_id = :userId) or (ct.closer_user_id = :userId)) group by p.id,p.period_end, p.description,ot.override_total,commission_total ORDER BY p.period_end ) as current_pay from brs.payroll p inner join brs.deal_commission_snapshot dcs on p.id = dcs.payroll_id left join commission_totals ct on ct.id = p.id left join override_totals ot on ot.id = p.id where((ot.user_id = :userId) or (ct.closer_user_id = :userId)) group by p.id,p.period_end, p.description ORDER BY p.period_end
sql.commissionManagement.getUserCommissions: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM ( SELECT d.deal_base_oid, d.customer_name, d.system_size, cp.name as commission_plan, src.source_name as source, stg.stage_name as stage, (cp.total * d.system_size - coalesce(cpv.source_cost, cpv_m2.source_cost, 0)) as deal_total_value, sum(dcl.amount) as paid_to_date, case when bool_or(d.cancelled_date is not null) then 0::numeric else ((cp.total * d.system_size - coalesce(cpv.source_cost, cpv_m2.source_cost, 0)) -- total value... - sum(dcl.amount)) -- ... minus paid to date end AS remaining_value FROM brs.deal d LEFT JOIN brs.deal_commission_ledger dcl on dcl.deal_id = d.id and ledger_type_id = 1 LEFT JOIN brs.source src on d.source_id = src.id LEFT JOIN brs.stage stg on d.current_stage_id = stg.id LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan_vw cpv on d.id = cpv.deal_id AND cpv.milestone_id = 1 LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan_vw cpv_m2 on d.id = cpv_m2.deal_id AND cpv_m2.milestone_id = 2 LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan cp on cp.id = cpv.commission_plan_id WHERE d.closer_user_id = :userId and installation_agreement_signed_date is not null AND (d.exclude_commission is null or d.exclude_commission is false) GROUP BY d.deal_base_oid, d.customer_name, d.system_size, src.source_name, stg.stage_name, cp.total, cp.name, cpv.source_cost, cpv_m2.source_cost UNION select deal.deal_base_oid, deal.customer_name, deal.system_size, null as commission_plan, source.source_name as source, stg.stage_name as stage, null as deal_total_value, null as paid_to_date, 0 as remaining_value from brs.deal left join brs.commission_plan_vw commission_plan_vw on deal.id = commission_plan_vw.deal_id left join brs.stage stg on deal.current_stage_id = stg.id join brs.source on deal.source_id = source.id where deal.closer_user_id = :userId and (deal.exclude_commission is null or deal.exclude_commission is false) and installation_agreement_signed_date is not null and commission_plan_vw.deal_id is null order by customer_name) AS sub_rows
sql.commissionManagement.getUserOverrides:
SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM ( SELECT d.id, d.deal_base_oid, d.customer_name, u.first_name||' '||u.last_name as closer_name, d.system_size, src.source_name as source, stg.stage_name as stage, opv.name as override_plan, (opru.allocation * d.system_size) AS override_total_value, sum(paid_to_date) AS paid_to_date, case when d.cancelled_date is not null then 0::numeric else ((opru.allocation * d.system_size) - sum(paid_to_date)) end AS remaining_value
FROM brs.deal_commission_ledger dcl INNER JOIN brs.deal d on d.id = dcl.deal_id inner join brs.user u on u.id = d.closer_user_id LEFT JOIN brs.source src on d.source_id = src.id LEFT JOIN brs.stage stg on d.current_stage_id = stg.id LEFT JOIN brs.override_plan_vw opv on d.id = opv.deal_id AND opv.milestone_id = 1 LEFT JOIN brs.override_plan_receiving_user opru on opv.override_plan_id = opru.override_plan_id AND opru.user_id = :userId
WHERE ledger_type_id = 3 AND (d.exclude_commission is null or d.exclude_commission is false) AND closer_id = :userId GROUP BY d.id, d.deal_base_oid, d.customer_name, d.system_size, source_name, stage_name, opru.allocation, opv.name,closer_name) AS sub_rows
sql.commissionManagement.findMilestoneCondit: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))), '[]') FROM ( SELECT mqc.id, qc.query_condition AS "queryCondition", qc.description AS "description", mt.milestone_type AS "milestone", mt.id AS "milestoneId", mt.display_order AS "displayOrder", qc.id, qc.child_query_condition_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(children))) FROM ( SELECT mqc2.id, qc2.query_condition AS "queryCondition", qc2.description AS "description", mt2.milestone_type AS "milestone", mt2.id AS "milestoneId", mt2.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.milestone_query_condition mqc2 INNER JOIN brs.query_condition qc2 ON mqc2.query_condition_id = qc2.id INNER JOIN brs.milestone_type mt2 ON mqc2.milestone_id = mt2.id where qc2.id = qc.child_query_condition_id ) children), '[]') AS children_milestones FROM brs.milestone_query_condition mqc INNER JOIN brs.query_condition qc ON mqc.query_condition_id = qc.id INNER JOIN brs.milestone_type mt ON mqc.milestone_id = mt.id WHERE mt.active IS TRUE AND qc.query_condition_type_id = :queryConditionTypeId ) sub_rows
sql.commissionManagement.getCommissionPlans: select cp.id, cp.name, cp.total, cp.status_id, cps.status_type, cp.description, count(cpu.id) filter (where (cpu.end_date is null OR cpu.end_date > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND cpu.start_date < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) as active_users from brs.commission_plan cp left join brs.commission_plan_user cpu on cp.id = cpu.commission_plan_id inner join brs.commission_plan_status cps on cp.status_id = cps.id WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND name != '' group by cp.id, cps.status_type order by cp.name;
sql.commissionManagement.getClosers:
SELECT u.id AS id, u.id AS userId, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, u.hire_date AS hireDate, u.user_status_type_id AS userStatusTypeId, cp.name AS commissionPlan, cp.description AS commissionDescription, cp.id AS commissionPlanId, op.name AS overridePlan, op.description AS overrideDescription, op.id AS overridePlanId, coalesce(( select case when up2.id is null then null else true end as closer_active from flow.user_position up2 where up2.user_id = u.id and up2.primary_flag IS TRUE AND up2.end_date IS NULL AND up2.archived IS NOT TRUE AND u.hire_date IS NOT NULL AND cust.has_access is true),false) AS "is_active_closer", (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM (SELECT op2.name AS "receivingPlan", op2.description AS "receivingDescription", op2.id AS "receivingPlanId"
FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opru INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op2 ON opru.override_plan_id = op2.id WHERE opru.user_id = u.id AND op2.status_id = 2) AS sub_rows) AS "receivingPlans" FROM flow.user u INNER JOIN flow.user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id AND ((up.primary_flag IS TRUE AND up.end_date IS NULL AND active IS TRUE) OR 1 = 1) AND position_id IN (1, 2, 3, 133) INNER JOIN flow.user_status_type ust ON ust.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.company_user_status_type cust on cust.id = ust.company_user_status_type_id and cust.has_access is true LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan_user cpu ON cpu.user_id = u.id AND (cpu.start_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (cpu.end_date >= current_timestamp OR cpu.end_date IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN brs.commission_plan cp ON cp.id = cpu.commission_plan_id LEFT JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON opau.user_id = u.id AND (opau.start_date <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (opau.end_date >= current_timestamp OR opau.end_date IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN brs.override_plan op ON opau.override_plan_id = op.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.hire_date, cp.name, cp.description, cp.id, op.name, op.description, op.id
sql.commissionManagement.getCloserDetails: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM (SELECT upv.user_id AS "userId", upv.first_name || ' ' || upv.last_name AS name, upv.start_date as "positionStartDate", upv.hire_date AS "hireDate", upv.position_name AS "positionName", (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(plans))) FROM (SELECT cpu.id as "userPlanId", cpu.start_date AS "startDate", cpu.end_date AS "endDate", cpu.note, cp.name , cp.id , cp.description FROM brs.commission_plan_user cpu INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan cp ON cp.id = cpu.commission_plan_id WHERE cpu.user_id = upv.user_id) AS plans) AS plans, (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(overrides))) FROM (SELECT opau.id, opau.user_id AS "userId", opau.start_date AS "startDate", opau.end_date AS "endDate", opau.note, op.id as "planId", op.name as "planName", op.description AS "planDescription" FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id WHERE opau.user_id = upv.user_id) AS overrides) AS overrides, (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(receiving))) FROM (SELECT op.name, opru.note, op.id, op.description FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opru INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op ON op.id = opru.override_plan_id WHERE opru.user_id = upv.user_id AND op.name IS NOT NULL AND op.name != '') AS receiving) AS receiving FROM brs.user_positions_vw upv WHERE upv.user_id = :userId) AS sub_rows
sql.commissionManagement.getCommissionPlanDe: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(sub_rows))) FROM (SELECT cp.id, cps.status_type, cp.name, cp.total, cp.description, cp.status_id, cu.first_name || ' ' || cu.last_name AS created_name, au.first_name || ' ' || au.last_name AS approved_name, cp.created_by, cp.position_id, cp.approved AS approved_date, (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(source))) FROM (SELECT cpsa.id, s.source_name, mt.milestone_type, ft.fee_type, cpsa.fee_amount, cpsa.source_id, cpsa.milestone_id, fee_type_id FROM brs.commission_plan_source_allocation cpsa INNER JOIN brs.milestone_type mt ON mt.id = cpsa.milestone_id INNER JOIN brs.fee_type ft ON ft.id = cpsa.fee_type_id INNER JOIN brs.source s ON s.id = cpsa.source_id WHERE cpsa.commission_plan_id = cp.id) AS source) AS source, (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(users))) FROM (SELECT cpu.id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') FILTER (WHERE CASE WHEN cp.position_id = 1 THEN up.position_id IN (1,2,3,133) WHEN cp.position_id = 4 THEN up.position_id IN (4,5,6) END ) AS position, u.id AS "userId", cpu.start_date AS "startDate", cpu.end_date AS "endDate", u.hire_date AS "hireDate" FROM brs.commission_plan_user cpu INNER JOIN brs.user u ON cpu.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN brs.user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN brs.position p ON p.id = up.position_id WHERE cpu.commission_plan_id = cp.id GROUP BY cpu.id, u.id) AS users) AS users, (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(milestones))) FROM (SELECT cpa.milestone_query_condition_id AS "queryConditionId", cpa.allocation, qc.query_condition AS "queryCondition", qc.description AS "description", mt.id AS "milestoneId", mt.milestone_type AS "milestone", mt.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.commission_plan_allocation cpa INNER JOIN brs.milestone_query_condition mqc ON mqc.id = cpa.milestone_query_condition_id INNER JOIN brs.query_condition qc ON qc.id = query_condition_id INNER JOIN brs.milestone_type mt ON mt.id = milestone_id WHERE cpa.commission_plan_id = cp.id) AS milestones) AS milestones FROM brs.commission_plan cp INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan_status cps ON cp.status_id = cps.id LEFT JOIN brs.user cu ON cp.created_by = cu.id LEFT JOIN brs.user au ON cp.approved_by = au.id WHERE cp.id = :planId) AS sub_rows;
sql.commissionManagement.getCommisionPlanUse: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(users))), '[]') FROM (SELECT cpu.id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, u.id AS "userId", cpu.start_date AS "startDate", cpu.end_date AS "endDate", u.hire_date AS "hireDate", string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') FILTER (WHERE CASE WHEN cp.position_id = 1 THEN up.position_id IN (1,2,3,133) WHEN cp.position_id = 4 THEN up.position_id IN (4,5,6) END ) AS position FROM brs.commission_plan_user cpu INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan cp ON cpu.commission_plan_id = cp.id INNER JOIN brs.user u ON cpu.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN brs.user_position up ON up.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN brs.position p ON p.id = up.position_id WHERE cp.id = :planId GROUP BY cpu.id, u.id) AS users
sql.commissionManagement.getAvailableSources: SELECT source_name as sourceName, id as sourceId FROM brs.source s WHERE source_type = 'deal' AND not (array[s.id] <@ :sourceIds)
sql.commissionPlan.editNote: UPDATE brs.commission_plan_user SET note = :note WHERE commission_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId
sql.commissionPlan.appendNote: UPDATE brs.commission_plan_user SET note = CONCAT_WS('; ', note, :note) WHERE commission_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId AND start_date = :startDate AND end_date IS NULL
sql.commissionPlan.appendNoteToPlan: UPDATE brs.commission_plan SET notes = CONCAT_WS('; ', notes, :note) WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.editAssignedNote: UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user SET note = :note WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId
sql.overridePlan.appendAssignedNote: UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user SET note = CONCAT_WS('; ', note, :note) WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId AND start_date = :startDate AND end_date IS NULL
sql.overridePlan.editReceivingNote: UPDATE brs.override_plan_receiving_user SET note = :note WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId
sql.commissionManagement.getSources: SELECT source_name as sourceName, id as sourceId FROM brs.source s WHERE source_type = 'deal'
sql.commissionManagement.getMilestones:
SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(milestones))) FROM ( SELECT
mt.milestone_type as "milestoneType", mt.id as "milestoneId", (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json("queryConditions"))) FROM (select mqc.id, qc.query_condition as "queryCondition", qc.description as "description" from brs.milestone_query_condition mqc inner join brs.query_condition qc on qc.id = mqc.query_condition_id WHERE mt.id = mqc.milestone_id AND query_condition_type_id = 1) AS "queryConditions") as "queryConditions" FROM brs.milestone_type mt ) as milestones;
sql.commissionManagement.getAvailableMilesto: SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(milestones))) FROM ( SELECT mt.milestone_type as "milestoneType", mt.id as "milestoneId", (SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json("queryConditions"))) FROM (select mqc.id, qc.query_condition as "queryCondition" from brs.milestone_query_condition mqc inner join brs.query_condition qc on qc.id = mqc.query_condition_id WHERE mt.id = mqc.milestone_id AND query_condition_type_id = 1 AND not (array[mt.id] <@ :milestoneIds)) AS "queryConditions") as "queryConditions" FROM brs.milestone_type mt ) as milestones;
sql.commissionManagement.getQueryConditions: SELECT query_condition as queryCondition, id as queryConditionId FROM brs.query_condition
sql.commissionManagement.saveSource: INSERT INTO brs.commission_plan_source_allocation (commission_plan_id, milestone_id, fee_amount, fee_type_id, source_id) VALUES (:planId, :milestoneId, :feeAmount, :feeTypeId, :sourceId)
sql.commissionManagement.insertUser: INSERT INTO brs.commission_plan_user (commission_plan_id, user_id, start_date, end_date) VALUES (:planId, :userId, :startDate, :endDate)
sql.commissionManagement.updateUser: UPDATE brs.commission_plan_user SET start_date = :startDate, end_date = :endDate WHERE id = :id
sql.commissionManagement.insertEndDate: WITH active_commission_plans AS (SELECT cpu.id, cp.id AS plan_id, cp.name AS plan_name, cpu.user_id, cpu.start_date, cpu.end_date FROM brs.commission_plan cp INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan_user cpu ON cp.id = cpu.commission_plan_id WHERE cp.status_id <> 3 AND cpu.end_date IS NULL AND cpu.start_date <= :startDate AND cpu.user_id = :userId) UPDATE brs.commission_plan_user cpu SET end_date = :startDate :: DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' FROM active_commission_plans p WHERE cpu.id = p.id
sql.commissionManagement.saveMilestone: INSERT INTO brs.commission_plan_allocation (allocation, commission_plan_id, milestone_query_condition_id) VALUES (:allocation, :planId, :milestoneQueryConditionId)
sql.commissionManagement.updateMilestone: UPDATE brs.commission_plan_allocation SET allocation = :allocation WHERE commission_plan_id = :planId AND milestone_query_condition_id = :milestoneQueryConditionId
sql.commissionManagement.findUsers: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(results))), '[]') FROM (SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS "userId", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, u.employee_id AS "employeeId", u.email, u.hire_date as "hireDate", (SELECT string_agg(distinct p1.position, ', ') FROM brs.user_position up1 INNER JOIN brs.position p1 ON p1.id = up1.position_id where up1.user_id = u.id AND CASE WHEN :positions = 'closers' THEN p1.id IN (1, 2, 3, 133) WHEN :positions = 'setters' THEN p1.id IN (4, 5, 6) END) AS position FROM brs."user" u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT up.user_id FROM brs.user_position up INNER JOIN brs.position p ON p.id = up.position_id WHERE ( CASE WHEN :positions = 'closers' THEN p.id IN (1, 2, 3, 133) WHEN :positions = 'setters' THEN p.id IN (4, 5, 6) END)) AND ( lower(first_name) || '' || lower(last_name) LIKE :search OR lower(last_name) LIKE :search OR lower(u.email) LIKE :search ) ORDER BY name LIMIT 10) results
sql.commissionManagement.removeMilestone: DELETE FROM brs.commission_plan_allocation WHERE milestone_query_condition_id = :id AND commission_plan_id = :planId
sql.commissionManagement.updateSource: UPDATE brs.commission_plan_source_allocation SET milestone_id = :milestoneId, fee_amount = :feeAmount, fee_type_id =:feeTypeId WHERE source_id = :sourceId AND commission_plan_id = :planId
sql.commissionManagement.removeSource: DELETE FROM brs.commission_plan_source_allocation WHERE source_id = :sourceId AND commission_plan_id = :planId
sql.commissionPlan.getCommissionPlanUserHist: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(aup))), '[]') FROM (SELECT cpu.id as "userPlanId", cpu.start_date AS "startDate", cpu.end_date AS "endDate", cp.name , cps.status_type AS status, cp.status_id AS statusId, cp.id FROM brs.commission_plan_user cpu INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan cp ON cpu.commission_plan_id = cp.id INNER JOIN brs.commission_plan_status cps ON cp.status_id = cps.id WHERE cpu.user_id = :userId ORDER BY cpu.end_date DESC) aup;
sql.commissionPlan.deleteUser: DELETE FROM brs.commission_plan_user WHERE commission_plan_id = :planId AND id = :userId;
sql.commissionPlan.create: INSERT INTO brs.commission_plan (name, description, total, position_id, created_by, created) VALUES (:name, :description, :total, 1, :createdBy, now()) RETURNING id
sql.commissionPlan.update: UPDATE brs.commission_plan SET name = :name, description = :description, total = :total WHERE id = :id RETURNING id
sql.commissionPlan.clone: SELECT clone_commission_plan AS id FROM brs.clone_commission_plan( :planId::int, :startDate::DATE, :users::int[], :createdBy::int)
sql.commissionPlan.approve: UPDATE brs.commission_plan SET approved = now(), approved_by = :approvedBy, status_id = :statusId WHERE id = :planId
sql.commissionPlan.inactivate: UPDATE brs.commission_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy, status_id = :statusId WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.create: INSERT INTO brs.override_plan (name, description, position_id, total, created_by, created, updated_by, updated) VALUES (:name, :description, :positionId, :total, :createdBy, now(), :createdBy, now()) RETURNING id
sql.overridePlan.update: UPDATE brs.override_plan SET name = :name, description = :description, position_id = :positionId, total = :total, updated_by = :updatedBy, updated = now() WHERE id = :id RETURNING id
sql.overridePlan.clone: SELECT clone_override_plan AS id FROM brs.clone_override_plan( :planId::int, :startDate:: DATE, :assignedUsers::int[], :receivingUsers::int[], :createdBy::int, :userId::int)
sql.overridePlan.getPlanStatus: SELECT status_type FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id WHERE op.id = :id
sql.overridePlan.updateReceivingUser: WITH new_user AS ( INSERT INTO brs.override_plan_receiving_user (override_plan_id, user_id, allocation) VALUES (:planId, :userId, :allocation) ON CONFLICT (override_plan_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET allocation = EXCLUDED.allocation RETURNING override_plan_id) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.deleteReceivingUser: WITH delete_user AS ( DELETE FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND user_id = :userId ) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.setEndDateAssignedUser: WITH active_user_plans AS (SELECT opau.id, op.id AS plan_id, op.name AS plan_name, ops.status_type, opau.user_id, opau.start_date, opau.end_date FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id AND opau.user_id = :userId WHERE op.status_id <> 3 AND opau.end_date IS NULL AND opau.start_date <= :startDate) UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user u SET end_date = :startDate :: DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' FROM active_user_plans p where u.id = p.id
sql.overridePlan.insertAssignedUser: WITH new_user AS ( INSERT INTO brs.override_plan_assigned_user (override_plan_id, user_id, start_date, end_date) VALUES (:planId, :userId, :startDate, :endDate) RETURNING override_plan_id ) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.updateAssignedUser: WITH update_assigned_user AS (UPDATE brs.override_plan_assigned_user SET start_date = :startDate, end_date = :endDate WHERE id = :id) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId;
sql.overridePlan.deleteAssignedUser: WITH delete_user AS ( DELETE FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND id = :userId ) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.updateMilestone: WITH new_milestone_alloc AS ( INSERT INTO brs.override_plan_milestone_allocation (override_plan_id, milestone_query_condition_id, allocation) VALUES (:planId, :queryConditionId, :allocation) ON CONFLICT (override_plan_id, milestone_query_condition_id) DO UPDATE SET allocation = EXCLUDED.allocation RETURNING override_plan_id) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.deleteMilestone: WITH delete_milestone_alloc AS ( DELETE FROM brs.override_plan_milestone_allocation WHERE override_plan_id = :planId AND milestone_query_condition_id = :queryConditionId) UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy WHERE id = :planId;
sql.overridePlan.approve: UPDATE brs.override_plan SET approved = now(), approved_by = :approvedBy, updated = now(), updated_by = :approvedBy, status_id = :statusId WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.inactivate: UPDATE brs.override_plan SET updated = now(), updated_by = :updatedBy, status_id = :statusId WHERE id = :planId
sql.overridePlan.findById:
SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM (SELECT op.id, op.name, op.description, op.total, ops.status_type AS status, op.position_id AS "positionId", (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM (SELECT u.id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name FROM brs."user" u WHERE u.id = op.created_by) u) AS "createdBy", op.created, (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM (SELECT u.id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name FROM brs."user" u WHERE u.id = op.updated_by) u) AS "updatedBy", op.updated, (SELECT row_to_json(u) FROM (SELECT u.id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name FROM brs."user" u WHERE u.id = op.approved_by) u) AS "approvedBy", op.approved, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))) FROM (SELECT opu.user_id AS "userId", opu.allocation, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, u.employee_id AS "employeeId", (select string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') from brs.user_position up inner join brs.position p on p.id = up.position_id where up.user_id = u.id
) AS position FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opu INNER JOIN brs."user" u ON opu.user_id = u.id WHERE override_plan_id = op.id GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) u), '[]') AS "receivingUsers", coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))) FROM (SELECT opa.id, opa.user_id AS "userId", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, u.employee_id AS "employeeId", u.hire_date AS "hireDate", opa.start_date AS "startDate", opa.end_date AS "endDate" FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opa INNER JOIN brs."user" u ON opa.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN brs.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN brs.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE opa.override_plan_id = op.id GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) u), '[]') AS "assignedUsers", coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(milestones))) FROM (SELECT opma.milestone_query_condition_id AS "queryConditionId", opma.allocation, qc.query_condition AS "queryCondition", qc.description AS "description", mt.id AS "milestoneId", mt.milestone_type AS "milestone", mt.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.override_plan_milestone_allocation opma INNER JOIN brs.milestone_query_condition mqc ON mqc.id = opma.milestone_query_condition_id INNER JOIN brs.query_condition qc ON qc.id = query_condition_id INNER JOIN brs.milestone_type mt ON mt.id = milestone_id WHERE opma.override_plan_id = op.id) AS milestones), '[]') AS milestones FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id WHERE op.id = :id) t;
sql.overridePlan.findUserHistory: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(aup))), '[]') FROM ( SELECT opau.id, op.id AS "planId", op.name AS "planName", ops.status_type AS status, opau.start_date AS "startDate", opau.end_date AS "endDate" FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id AND opau.user_id = :userId ORDER BY opau.end_date DESC ) aup
sql.overridePlan.findUsers:
SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(results))), '[]') FROM (SELECT u.id AS "userId", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, u.employee_id AS "employeeId", u.email, u.hire_date as "hireDate", (SELECT string_agg( distinct position, ', ') FROM brs.user_position up1 INNER JOIN brs.position p1 ON p1.id = up1.position_id WHERE up1.user_id = u.id AND CASE WHEN :positions = 1 THEN p1.id IN (1, 2, 3) WHEN :positions = 4 THEN p1.id IN (4, 5, 6) END) AS position, coalesce((SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(aup))) FROM (SELECT op.id, op.name, ops.status_type AS status, opau.start_date AS "startDate", opau.end_date AS "endDate" FROM brs.override_plan op INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_status ops ON op.status_id = ops.id INNER JOIN brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau ON op.id = opau.override_plan_id AND opau.user_id = u.id WHERE op.status_id <> 3 AND opau.end_date IS NULL OR opau.end_date >= current_date) aup), '[]') AS "assignedUserPlans" FROM brs."user" u WHERE ( lower(trim(first_name)) || '' || lower(trim(last_name)) LIKE :search OR lower(trim(last_name)) LIKE :search OR lower(trim(u.email)) LIKE :search ) AND (CASE WHEN :positions:: INT IS NOT NULL THEN u.id IN (SELECT up.user_id FROM brs.user_position up INNER JOIN brs.position p ON p.id = up.position_id WHERE ( CASE WHEN :positions = 1 THEN p.id IN (1, 2, 3) WHEN :positions = 4 THEN p.id IN (4, 5, 6) END)) ELSE 1 = 1 END)
ORDER BY first_name, last_name LIMIT 10) results;
sql.overridePlan.getAssignedUsers: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))), '[]') FROM (SELECT opa.id, opa.user_id AS "userId", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, u.employee_id AS "employeeId", u.hire_date AS "hireDate", opa.start_date AS "startDate", opa.end_date AS "endDate", string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') FILTER ( WHERE CASE WHEN op.position_id = 1 THEN up.position_id IN (1,2,3) WHEN op.position_id = 4 THEN up.position_id IN (4,5,6) END ) AS position FROM brs.override_plan_assigned_user opa INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op ON opa.override_plan_id = op.id INNER JOIN brs."user" u ON opa.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN brs.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN brs.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE op.id = :planId AND up.active IS TRUE GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) u
sql.overridePlan.getReceivingUsers: SELECT coalesce(array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(u))), '[]') FROM (SELECT opu.user_id AS "userId", opu.allocation, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS name, u.employee_id AS "employeeId", up.active, string_agg(DISTINCT p.position, ', ') FILTER ( WHERE CASE WHEN op.position_id = 1 THEN up.position_id IN (1,2,3) WHEN op.position_id = 4 THEN up.position_id IN (4,5,6) END ) AS position FROM brs.override_plan_receiving_user opu INNER JOIN brs.override_plan op ON opu.override_plan_id = op.id INNER JOIN brs."user" u ON opu.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN brs.user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id INNER JOIN brs.position p ON up.position_id = p.id WHERE op.id = :planId AND up.active IS TRUE GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) u;
sql.overridePlan.export: select op.name, u.first_name||' '||u.last_name closer, opau.start_date, opau.end_date, op.total, ops.status_type, (select allocation from brs.override_plan_milestone_allocation opma inner join brs.milestone_query_condition mqc on opma.milestone_query_condition_id = mqc.id and milestone_id = 1 where opma.override_plan_id = op.id) as milestone_1_allocation, (select allocation from brs.override_plan_milestone_allocation opma inner join brs.milestone_query_condition mqc on opma.milestone_query_condition_id = mqc.id and milestone_id = 2 where opma.override_plan_id = op.id) as milestone_2_allocation, json_object_agg(u1.first_name||' '||u1.last_name, opru.allocation) receiving_users from brs.override_plan op inner join brs.override_plan_assigned_user opau on opau.override_plan_id = op.id inner join brs.user u on u.id = opau.user_id inner join brs.override_plan_status ops on ops.id = op.status_id inner join brs.override_plan_receiving_user opru on opru.override_plan_id = op.id inner join brs.user u1 on u1.id = opru.user_id group by op.name, closer, opau.start_date, opau.end_date, total, status_type, milestone_1_allocation, milestone_2_allocation;
sql.commissionAdmin.getMilestoneList: select milestone_type, milestone_id, qct.query_condition_type, description, query_condition, query_condition_id, qc.id as "queryConditionId", mqc.id as "milestoneQueryConditionId" FROM brs.milestone_type mt INNER JOIN brs.milestone_query_condition mqc on mt.id = mqc.milestone_id INNER JOIN brs.query_condition qc on mqc.query_condition_id = qc.id inner join brs.query_condition_type qct on qct.id = qc.query_condition_type_id order by query_condition_type, mt.milestone_type
sql.commissionAdmin.save: UPDATE brs.query_condition SET query_condition = :condition WHERE id = :id
sql.commissions.getAdjustmentData: select (select brs.get_commissions_earned(array[ :dealId ], :endDate)) as commissions_earned, (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from brs.payroll_adjustment where deal_id = :dealId and payroll_adjustment_type_id = 1 and created <= :endDate) as adjustments_given, coalesce( (SELECT case when cp.commission_plan_id is null then case when d.source_id in (4,5,375) then coalesce(round(200.00*d.system_size,2), 0) else coalesce(round(100.00*d.system_size,2), 0) end else coalesce(round(cp.allocation*cp.system_size-coalesce(cp.source_cost,0),2), 0) end as total FROM brs.deal d inner join brs.source s on s.id = d.source_id left JOIN brs.commission_plan_vw cp ON cp.deal_id = d.id and cp.greatest_date <= now()::date AND milestone_id = 1 AND query_condition_type_id = 1 WHERE d.id = :dealId),0) + coalesce( (SELECT case when cp.commission_plan_id is null then 0.00 else coalesce(round(cp.allocation*cp.system_size-coalesce(source_cost,0),2), 0) end as total FROM brs.deal d inner join brs.source s on s.id = d.source_id left JOIN brs.commission_plan_vw cp ON cp.deal_id = d.id WHERE (d.substantial_completion_date IS NULL OR d.substantial_completion_date <= now()::date) AND cp.greatest_date <= now()::date AND cp.milestone_id = 2 AND cp.query_condition_type_id = 1 AND d.id = :dealId),0) as deal_total_value;
sql.commissions.getUserDatesAsCloser: select user_id, start_date::date, end_date::date from brs.user_position where position_id in (1,2,3,133) and user_id in (:userIds);
